description: Get one session's bars across one expiration, by strike: open, high, low, close, volume, VWAP and trades for every contract, active or expired. Use it for how a chain traded on a past date; GetOptionExpirations with expired=true lists past expirations. A larger expiration returns the strikes nearest that session's stock close; narrow with minStrike/maxStrike and type. History begins in early 2024. Plus can read a session 30 minutes after the stock close; the Free plan is answered with an upgrade note. Open interest, implied volatility, greeks and bid/ask have no history. US tickers only.

maxStrike.description: Only include strikes at or below this price

minStrike.description: Only include strikes at or above this price

type.description: Contract type: call or put (default: both)

name: GetOptionChainSession
title: Option Chain Session
